name: The Atal'ai Exile
summary: At Stonard, Fel'zerul sends you north with the artifacts from the Pool of Tears. Find an exiled Atal'ai priest in the Hinterlands and learn what the artifacts are for.

sections.title: A Sentence in Blood
sections.body: A blood-marked scroll sentences an Atal'ai priest to a fate worse than death among his own people. He is sent to live with the Witherbark trolls, far north in the Hinterlands. Fel'zerul bundles the artifacts and sends you to find the exile, learn their true use, and return.

sections.title: The Exile's Words
sections.body: The Atal'ai exile names the artifacts as tools for summoning when shown the bundle. He says Jammal'an the Prophet is leading the disciples of the Chamber of Blood toward their chosen fate. The exile wonders whether Hakkar has returned to the temple.

faq.q: Who sends you to find the Atal'ai Exile?
faq.answer: Fel'zerul in Stonard sends you north with the artifacts you gathered.

faq.q: Where is the Atal'ai Exile located?
faq.answer: The Atal'ai Exile lives with the Witherbark trolls at the temple of Shadra'Alor in the Hinterlands.

faq.q: What sentence was passed on the priest?
faq.answer: A blood-marked scroll sentences the priest to exile among the Witherbark trolls in the Hinterlands, a fate worse than death among the Atal'ai.

faq.q: What are you carrying to the exile?
faq.answer: You carry Atal'ai artifacts gathered at the Pool of Tears. Fel'zerul wants the exile to reveal their true use.

faq.q: What comes directly before this journey?
faq.answer: Your journey follows Pool of Tears, where Fel'zerul had you gather Atal'ai artifacts.
